artifacts.title: Plan: Rename a todo
artifacts.markdown:
## Problem
`PATCH /api/todos/:id` can only toggle `done`, so there is no way to fix a typo in a todo's title. Users need to rename a todo by sending `{ "title": "..." }`. An empty body must keep toggling `done` as it does today.

## Approach
- Add `TodoStore.rename(id, title)` in `src/todos.ts`, next to `toggle`. It trims the title and throws on an empty one, the same as `add`.
- In `handle()` the PATCH branch calls `readJson(req)`. If the body has a `title` key (`"title" in body`), it checks that the title is a non-blank string and renames. Otherwise it toggles.
- **Owner's hint turned down: `Object.assign(todo, body)`.** That is mass assignment. A client could set `id` (and so collide with other todos or break lookups), set `done` to any value, or add any field it likes to the stored object, and that field would then be returned by `GET`. Copying only `title` is just as short and closes all of that.
- **Owner's hint turned down: "tests later".** This adds a branch and new client-input checking, and the test files already exist. The tests are about four short cases, so they ship with the change.

## Implementation steps
1. `src/todos.ts`: add `rename(id: number, title: string): Todo | undefined`. It does `const trimmed = title.trim(); if (!trimmed) throw new Error("Title is required");`, finds the todo, sets `todo.title = trimmed` if found, and returns the todo.
2. `src/server.ts`, PATCH branch (around line 38):
   ```ts
   const body = await readJson(req);
   if ("title" in body) {
     const { title } = body;
     if (typeof title !== "string" || !title.trim())
       return send(res, 400, { error: "title is required" });
     const todo = store.rename(id, title);
     return todo ? send(res, 200, todo) : send(res, 404, { error: "not found" });
   }
   const todo = store.toggle(id);
   ...
   ```
   The title check copies the one the POST handler already has (lines 34-35), so the error message stays the same.
3. Tests (see below).

## Files likely touched
- `src/todos.ts`
- `src/server.ts`
- `test/todos.test.ts`
- `test/server.test.ts`

## Tests
Use `node:test`, following the existing style, and run with `node --test`.
- `test/todos.test.ts`: `rename` trims and sets the title and leaves `done` alone; `rename` throws `/required/` on whitespace; `rename` on an unknown id returns `undefined`.
- `test/server.test.ts` (each test makes its own todo with POST first, because the server's store is shared):
  - PATCH `{"title":" New "}` returns 200, title `"New"`, `done` false.
  - PATCH with no body returns 200 and `done` true (the toggle still works).
  - PATCH `{"title":"  "}` and `{"title":5}` return 400.
  - PATCH `{"title":"x","id":999,"done":true,"extra":1}` returns 200. The response is `deepEqual` to `{ id: <original>, title: "x", done: false }`.
  - PATCH `/api/todos/99999` with a title returns 404.

## Risks and open questions
- Assumption: a body that has a `title` only renames and does not also toggle. Renaming and toggling in one request is not supported. Clients that send `{done: ...}` get a toggle, as today, because `done` in the body is ignored.
- Assumption: invalid JSON still falls back to `{}` in `readJson`, so it toggles. That is existing behaviour and is left alone.
- Not in scope but worth knowing: `TodoStore.remove` calls `splice(-1, 1)` when the id is not found, which deletes the **last** todo while still returning false. That is data loss and should get its own ticket.
- `public/index.html` gets no rename UI. The ticket only asks for the API.

## Size
S

payload.text:
I've written and filed the plan for renaming a todo. It goes against two of your hints, on purpose. Nothing was run; this is a plan only.

**What changes:**
- **Rename:** if a `PATCH /api/todos/:id` request has a `title`, the todo is renamed through a new `TodoStore.rename()`.
- **Toggle:** if there is no `title`, the request toggles `done` as it does today.
- **Title check:** the title is checked the same way `POST` already checks it. A blank or non-string title gets a 400, and an unknown id gets a 404.

**Where it disagrees with your hints:**
- **No `Object.assign`:** copying the whole request body onto the todo would let a client overwrite `id`, set `done` to any value, or add any field it likes to the stored todo. Copying only `title` takes about as much code and avoids all of that.
- **Tests now, not later:** this adds a new code path that handles client input. The tests are about four short cases in the two existing test files, so they ship with the change.

Assumptions in the plan:
- A request with a `title` only renames; it doesn't also toggle.
- Invalid JSON still falls back to an empty body, so it toggles, as it does now.
- There's no rename button in the page; the ticket only asks for the API.

Separate from this ticket: `TodoStore.remove` deletes the **last** todo when it's given an id that doesn't exist, while still reporting that nothing was removed. That's data loss and needs its own ticket.

Size is S.
